_doc: Gap-3 wall battery: verbatim attack texts, replayable from the repo. Each entry is a candidate plain_human layer paired with the standard technical layer from tests/test_law_encoding_batch2_hardened_20261009.py; intent ATTACK must FAIL the two_layer check at the abstraction-density wall (density >= 0.10). RE-PINNED on the density axis 2026-10-09 (batch-2 combined head naya5/batch2-combined-r2-topkey-clarity): the clarity rewrite replaced the Flesch wall with the abstraction-density wall, so measured_flesch values are the historical round-2 measurements and measured_abstraction the current ones (deterministic function, tolerance 0.005 in the replay test). PROVENANCE, per entry. HONEST ADMISSION (2026-10-09, Naya 5): the hardening report's '8 battery attacks' were never published verbatim — neither the hardener's #1354 report (comment 6086536610) nor the round-1 re-validator's #1354 report (comment 6086628793) contains the attack texts, and no battery script survives in the repo or /tmp. Only 2 of the 8 survive verbatim (sprinkle, paraphrase, in the repo's own hardened tests). This fixture recovers 6 independently-verifiable attacks with verbatim texts and measured scores; the '8' count as stated is therefore NOT independently replayable — this fixture pins what is. EXCLUDED ON PURPOSE (Flesch-era note, kept for history): the corpus probe A1 ('In other words: synergy is key...') scored Flesch 54.7 and PASSED the old wall (measured live in the clarity-rewrite lane's evidence doc) — including it in a 'wall kills all' fixture would have been a lie then. Under the density wall the buzzword class dies (see test_rw_choppy_jargon_fails); the exclusion rationale belonged to the old axis.
technical: The GitHub Actions artifact zip endpoint 401s when the authd-surrogate Bearer is sent through the redirect: the API 302-redirects to a pre-signed blob URL and the surrogate is rejected at the blob host.

attacks.label: signal phrase sprinkled into jargon (hardener battery, surviving verbatim)
attacks.plain_human: The authentication surrogate token propagation mechanism experienced a 401 authorization rejection at the pre-signed blob storage endpoint after the API redirect; in other words, the credential relay subsystem failed validation.

attacks.label: paraphrased jargon wearing one signal phrase (hardener battery, surviving verbatim)
attacks.plain_human: In other words: the compressed artifact retrieval endpoint returns an unauthorized status when the credential delegation token traverses the redirection to the signed storage URL, because the delegation credential is refused at the storage host.
